objects.description: During the [2016 Ukraine Electric Power Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025), [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) masqueraded executables as `.txt` files.(Citation: Dragos Crashoverride 2018)
